The question asks which residue is phosphorylated. Looking at the PDB, chain B residue 3 is labeled TPO (phosphothreonine) with a phosphate group (P, O1P, O2P, O3P). So the answer is B:T3.

The residue identifier format: chain:one-letter code + author residue number. TPO is phosphothreonine, one-letter code T, chain B, residue 3. So B:T3.
